variant.briefing:
Hey,

We’ve got an opportunity for any haulers interested in lending a hand or two to Citizens for Prosperity.

There’s a box that needs to be moved from [Location] to [Destination]. Shouldn’t take long, if you’re around the outpost and available. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
